basic.title: Senior Software Engineer
basic.location: West Islip, NY | Remote or Hybrid
basic.summary: Senior software engineer with 10 years building production systems across distributed backend services, data-intensive applications, machine learning, cloud platforms, and user-facing products. Work spans search and ranking, predictive analytics, NLP, real-time data pipelines, APIs, interactive web applications, and the infrastructure needed to operate them reliably at scale. Currently focused on AI-enabled software for utility planning and operations, combining product engineering, geospatial and time-series data, predictive models, cloud-native services, and production observability.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built product and platform capabilities across Trinnex's waterCAST digital-water ecosystem and Capacity Planner, combining web applications, distributed backend services, utility data, predictive analytics, and cloud infrastructure in one production platform.

Developed backend services and APIs that combined GIS, hydraulic-model, asset, operational, and time-series data for capacity analysis and planning workflows, reducing multi-system data preparation by 57% for repeat evaluations.

Built interactive planning and analytics workflows that let utility engineers explore network conditions, compare development scenarios, and inspect capacity constraints without moving between modeling tools and separate reporting systems.

Developed machine-learning pipelines for demand forecasting, anomaly detection, and infrastructure-risk scoring using historical flow, weather, asset, and operational signals, improving early identification of abnormal conditions by 36% in evaluation datasets.

Designed feature-engineering and model-evaluation workflows for predictive utility models, separating training, validation, and production feature generation so model behavior remained reproducible as new sensor and operational data arrived.

Built event-driven ingestion pipelines for GIS updates, telemetry, and operational records, using schema validation, deduplication, and incremental processing to keep analytical and predictive datasets current without full reloads.

Implemented low-latency service paths for analytical and model-derived results using Python APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis caching, and asynchronous processing, cutting p95 response time by 42% on high-cost scenario requests.

Developed TypeScript and React product surfaces for maps, scenario comparison, capacity metrics, and model-derived insights, reducing the number of manual steps in a typical planning workflow from 11 to 6.

Introduced automated model and data-quality checks around drift, forecast error, missing telemetry, and failed feature generation, surfacing production-quality issues within hours instead of during periodic analyst review.

Containerized application and model services and standardized Kubernetes deployment, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, health checks, and staged rollout patterns, reducing failed production releases by 44%.
Instrumented backend, data, and model-serving paths with metrics, structured logs, and distributed tracing, reducing median incident isolation time by 39% across cross-service failures.

Led architecture and code reviews across application, backend, data, and cloud work, mentoring engineers on distributed-system boundaries, model-operability concerns, API design, and production debugging.
experience.notes: waterCAST and Capacity Planner are used as the Trinnex project anchor. Numeric impact figures and candidate-specific implementation details are synthetic test data for resume-generation testing unless independently verified. The role is intentionally positioned as broad production software engineering with AI/ML, data, product, and cloud depth rather than as a DevOps-only role.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Delivered production software and data-intensive systems for enterprise clients across regulated and high-scale environments, owning architecture from application and API design through cloud deployment and operational handoff.

Applied machine learning, NLP, forecasting, and analytical modeling to client workflows where predictive or automated decision support replaced manual review and rules-based processing.

Led technical design and delivery across application, data, AI, and platform teams, translating business constraints into scalable systems with measurable reliability, security, and operational requirements.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built backend services for a biomedical knowledge-discovery platform that turned scientific literature into searchable evidence for pharmaceutical and biotechnology research teams.
Developed NLP pipelines for biomedical entity and relationship extraction, converting unstructured research text into structured gene, disease, target, and evidence records.
Implemented search and ranking workflows over extracted biomedical evidence, improving the path from broad scientific queries to the most relevant supporting literature.
Built data-processing pipelines that normalized and enriched large document collections before NLP inference, reducing malformed records and inconsistent downstream features.
Integrated extracted relationships into a graph-oriented discovery layer so researchers could explore multi-hop connections across targets, diseases, mechanisms, and supporting evidence.
Instrumented model and pipeline quality checks around extraction precision, document coverage, and failed-processing cases so regressions were visible before new models reached research users.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built backend and data services supporting Zillow's property-search and valuation experiences, serving model-derived housing information across high-traffic consumer surfaces.
Developed distributed pipelines that combined property facts, listing updates, comparable sales, and market signals into model-ready datasets used by valuation and search systems.

Implemented production serving paths for automated valuation outputs, separating expensive model computation from latency-sensitive consumer requests through precomputation, caching, and asynchronous refresh.
Worked on evaluation workflows comparing predicted home values with subsequent transaction outcomes, giving model teams repeatable accuracy measurements across changing markets and geographies.
Built event-driven processing for new and updated listings so property changes reached downstream search, analytics, and predictive systems without waiting for full batch reloads.
Optimized high-volume service and database access paths through indexing, caching, profiling, and query redesign, reducing tail latency on property and search requests.
Supported controlled experimentation around ranking and consumer-facing property features, using behavioral and quality metrics to determine whether changes should progress beyond limited rollout.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built distributed components in the Google Search serving path, supporting retrieval and ranking of candidate results under interactive latency requirements at global request scale.
Developed large-scale MapReduce and Flume pipelines over search and web data used to refresh indexes and derive signals for retrieval and ranking workflows.
Worked on ranking and relevance infrastructure that combined multiple search signals into production result ordering, with offline evaluation used to measure changes before rollout.
Optimized latency-sensitive RPC and data-access paths, diagnosing tail-latency regressions that propagated across dependent Search services.
Improved Borg job scheduling and resource utilization for production Search workloads, freeing capacity without compromising serving reliability.
Refined Borgmon alerting and failure detection for tier-1 services, reducing noisy pages and making genuine serving regressions easier for on-call engineers to isolate.
